paper_metadata.title: Tensile Creep Properties of Cr-Si Alloys at 980 °C in Air—Influence of Ge and Mo Addition

evidence.quote: The tensile creep behavior of Cr-Si alloys with Cr ≥ 91 at.% was investigated in air at 980 ◦C with a constant load of 50–100 MPa.

The investigated alloys in this work are a binary alloy consisting of Cr and 9 at.% Si (Cr91Si9) and two ternary alloys consisting of 7 at.% Si and 2 at.% Ge or Mo, respectively (Cr91Si7Ge2 and Cr91Si7Mo2).
